text:
Greta Oyelaran has been appointed conductor of the Halewyn Philharmonic, the orchestra announced on 14 March 2025. She will take up the post at the start of the 2025-26 season.

The appointment is set out in the board's official press release, "Appointment of Music Director," which was issued after the board voted on 13 March. Tobias Verhaegen, Chair of the Halewyn Philharmonic Board, confirmed the decision.

According to the release, Oyelaran has signed a four-year contract. Her first season is scheduled to include 62 performances.

The press release is the basis for this report. The Continental Record has relied on its text and on Mr Verhaegen's confirmation of the board's decision, and has not drawn on any other account of the vote.
